claude-opus-5[1m]

# `eds2-app` — expected findings

Consumer fixture for `--ui-kit eds2` (design §4). No `node_modules`: every path below is a
source coordinate inside this directory, and every claim about the kit that a row relies on is
carried in `WORKFLOW/features/eds2/reports/s1-v2-facts.md` with its own `../ui-kit-eds-ce-2`
reference.

Line numbers are the CURRENT ones. **They were re-anchored once**, by A9: this fixture was the
last tree in the repository the formatter had not been run over, and `pnpm fmt` reflows JSX. Only
the two `.tsx` files with multi-line elements moved (`components/PrimaryButton.tsx`,
`components/StatusBadge.tsx`, `features/ProfileDialog.tsx`); no row was added, removed or
re-aimed, and every `.css.ts` coordinate is untouched. A row's `file:line` is the anchor line — the declaration the
finding is expected to point at; a rule that reports a narrower span (a property, an attribute)
is still satisfied as long as it lands inside the anchor's statement.

Rule ids are the ones the registry emits today (`packages/fg-analyzer-engine/src/rules/**` for
the 11 engine ids, `packages/fg-eds-adapter/src/rules/**` for the adapter's). Rows marked
**BLOCKED-ON** name the engine/adapter capability that must exist first (design §2/§3); until
that lands, the row is a specification, not a passing assertion.

## A. Must fire

| rule id                                                       | file:line                                               | why it must fire                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `token.literal.color` (exact)                                 | `src/components/PrimaryButton.css.ts:18`                | `backgroundColor: '#2969e3'` is the _exact_ light value of `edsSys.Background.backAccent` (and of `edsRef.palette.electric.electric700`, `edsSys.Border.borderAccent`, …) — a token exists and was not used. The suggestion carries **both** channels — `jsPath: themeTokens.edsSys.Background.backAccent` AND `cssVar: --sds-eng-edsSys-Background-backAccent` — and `value` is the js path because the file is a `.css.ts`. **Re-aimed by V6 #9 and #4**: E4/E8's `cssVar: null` was superseded by design §6 (v2 custom-property names are stable, so both channels exist), and which one is `value` is decided by the FILE's syntax, not by the profile. The token must be `edsSys.*`, never the `edsRef` twin (V6 #1). |
| `token.literal.color` (near)                                  | `src/components/PrimaryButton.css.ts:23`                | `#2a6ae4` is one step off `#2969e3`; the near-match branch must resolve it to the same token rather than report "no token".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `token.literal.color` (**shade**)                             | `src/components/PrimaryButton.css.ts:24`                | `#7c3aed` is 0.058 in OKLab from `ref.palette.orchid40` — inside the `shade` band, so it is GRADED `shade` and the message names that token. **Re-aimed by V6 #8**: «no token in the 1079-token set» was never true. The replacement is still withheld, for the other reason (V6 #1): `ref` is a primitive tier and `tierViolation: any-colour` makes naming it an error, so `expected` is `null`, `autoFixable` is `false`, and the `note` says «Ближайший токен — примитив ref.palette.orchid40; семантической роли «background» …».                                                                                                                                                                                     |

Only the `.sds-eng-*` half may be reported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| any finding                                                 | `src/**/*.css.ts` `import` lines                                                                                           | `@vanilla-extract/css` and `@vanilla-extract/recipes` are the styling engine the kit itself prescribes, not a foreign styling stack.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `component.custom` / `component.fork`                       | `src/components/StatusBadge.tsx:11`, `src/features/ProfileDialog.tsx:17`                                                   | Neither is a clone of a kit component, so neither may be CLAIMED as one. **`component.ambiguous` (info) MAY appear on both, and is not a violation of this table** — V6 #11, investigated and left in place: `StatusBadge` scores 0.41 against `PasswordField` on two weak signals (a shared `<button>` tag, damped to 0.5 × 0.6, and a CSS-property overlap of 0.5 × 0.3), and `ProfileDialog` scores 0.455 against `Modal` because `Dialog` is one of `Modal`'s recorded synonyms — which is a real name signal. The 0.3/0.6 grading band and every weight live in `packages/fg-eds-adapter/src/rules/components/custom.ts:47-48` and `src/components/score.ts:44-51`, neither of which reads the profile: they are the EDS 1.x algorithm, shared by both adapters, so moving them would move the v1 parity goldens (design E7). `component.ambiguous` withholds the claim by construction — «похож …, но не настолько, чтобы утверждать дубль — проверьте руками» — which is the honest verdict for both. |

## C. Counts to assert

| what                                               | expected                                                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| source files scanned                               | 14 (`src/**/*.{ts,tsx}`; `package.json`/`tsconfig.json`/`EXPECTED.txt` are not sources)                                             |
| files with at least one finding                    | 10 — everything under `src/` except `theme/tokens.css.ts`, `components/IconLegend.tsx`, `components/StatusBadge.css.ts`, `App.tsx` |
| files that must stay clean                         | 4 (`src/theme/tokens.css.ts`, `src/components/IconLegend.tsx`, `src/components/StatusBadge.css.ts`, `src/App.tsx`)                 |
| limitations of reason `unresolved-token-reference` | ≥ 1, anchored at `src/features/LoginForm.css.ts:22`                                                                                |
| findings of rule `import.bypass`                   | exactly 0                                                                                                                          |
| findings of rule `api.dnu`                         | exactly 0                                                                                                                          |

| distinct rule ids that fire                        | ≥ 19                                                                                                                               |

## D. Things this fixture deliberately does NOT cover

- The `comp` tier: all 30 of its tokens are empty contracts in the kit itself (facts report §1c),
  so there is no consumer-visible value to match against.
- Dark mode: only `edsSys` has a dark theme and only 78 of its tokens differ, so a dark-only
  finding would test the theme rather than the analyzer.
- `@sds-eng/base-exp/<Component>` subpath imports: they are DECLARED `exports` keys, so whether
  they may be reported is an open policy question for A9 (facts report §5, break V2), not a
  settled expectation. Adding a row for them now would freeze the wrong answer.
